title: The Parish of Windrow House
author: Wendell Reyes
blurb: Lior Almeida, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
